releases.displayName: The Dawn’s Children are ready to fight! New features of the November update

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/ece63186d3c7e93354e33a6979e07a76d1014076.png"]
Hello, survivors! We’re almost done reviewing the new parts of the Dawn’s Children. The third developer blog entry is about the legendary light cabin and laser shotgun. Let’s dive in!

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This also applies to all visual materials.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/9db06a5d41e83cc1d3e2b4e28f41a2d5de9fd0ea.jpg"]
The “Geryon” has a truly unique feature that makes it a highly efficient weapon in almost any situation: a personal protective field! Let’s take a closer look.

As the successor to the “Gravastar”, it faithfully serves as a laser shotgun, just like its predecessor, but its personal protective field allows you to fight more boldly. Even when the weapon’s durability runs out, don’t even think about running away! Finish off the enemy instead, because the “Geryon” heats up enemy parts when the protective field is destroyed. The heating effect, however, only lasts for the next few shots, so don’t miss: the field doesn’t regenerate quickly.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/b06c1e7cb477eb050051676aa8f1e274cdcf81e5.jpg"]

The Dawn’s Children have clearly found some books on Greek mythology, and they must have enjoyed them. “Persephone” is a good choice for wizards those who like to deal damage using heating and freezing effects.

The main feature of the cabin is that it adds a certain percentage to the heating and freezing effects of equipped weapons, provided their projectiles possess these effects. If you activate the bonus, this boost will temporarily increase even further, and the weapon will begin to deal more damage to the enemy’s heated and frozen parts.

notes.title: Structural parts of the new season

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/db99183260a43f722116a7037751a2c174a5120e.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/81cba9a06565d7dfcff30df2856b94f4b51d1833.jpg"]
The next update will also bring many other changes.

Remember the “Short circuit” brawl? The mode has been reworked, and now you’ll have the chance to temporarily try it out in arcade PvP missions. A new mode inspired by the popular “flag capture” mechanic will also be making its way into the brawls of the new season. There are two bases and two trophies (survivors love stealing resources from each other); defend your team’s trophy and try to deliver the enemy’s back to your base. Classic.

In addition, the update will also include a number of other changes and improvements, as well as fixes for known bugs and the release of previously announced balance changes. You can also expect minor QoL changes to the “Storage” and “Workbenches” interface tabs, among others.

This entry completes our series of blog posts about the new season, and you can learn all about the new rewards and features during our traditional livestream, which will take place next week. Stay tuned for updates, and good luck in battles!

releases.displayName: The Dawn’s Children are ready to fight! New features of the November update

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/e68f9abd26ca80a18503bad19b62c3a8523f7067.png"]

Hello, survivors! In this entry, we continue to tell you about the new parts created by the Dawn’s Children. This time, we’ll take a look at the legendary plasma cutter and the epic hover/wheel. Let’s dive in!

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This also applies to all visual materials.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/ae881ddb4b73a54e206c5764296670cfc3611b05.jpg"]
“Orthogon” is short for orthogonal, by the way. If you know, you know. The name is a perfect fit for a weapon that can rotate 90°.

“Orthogon” is a legendary successor to the “Blockchain”. As its predecessor, it also has a wide beam of heated plasma that can hit enemies immediately after a short charge. But the new cutter also has three new features: it can heat up parts, increase its own damage upon a successful hit, and rotate its barrel 90°! After the rotation, the beam it fires becomes vertical.

The weapon has two firing modes, horizontal and vertical. You need to rapidly press the fire button twice to switch between the modes by rotating the barrel 90°. With each subsequent switch, the barrel will continue to rotate in a circle with each turn being 90°. The weapon deals energy damage, but each hit also heats up enemy parts.

“Orthogon’s” unique feature is its charge accumulation. With every hit on an enemy, the cutter accumulates charge, and when fully charged, turning the barrel provides three amplified shots. These shots have increased damage, width, and heating. The amplified shots also accumulate charge, but for the other firing mode. Therefore, every hit contributes to the next turning, and the cycle repeats.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/8d0772c0c3091bf8f15e04f837bcd98404791ed2.jpg"]

The new movement part is reminiscent of Phaethon’s chariot. It won’t get you close to the sun but can still lift you up above the Wasteland. It also is visually similar to the wheels of a car from a famous film about time travel.
The movement part has two modes: a wheel and a hover. It starts out as a wheel, which can rotate and fly like a hover upon activation.

The “Phaethon’s” unique feature is related to its wheel mode. In this mode, the maximum speed limit is removed, and at the same time, hover power is boosted by a certain percentage. For every few meters traveled on the ground, the length of this boost increases by a certain amount of time, up to several times the initial duration.

notes.title: Structural parts of the new season

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/2da625d2f00adc92db7af62c57a1f1d850ffab23.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/ca4653da6c7df47a6c3101129af49910d0f3c9cb.jpg"]
That’s not all! The final developer blog entry will be out very soon. Stay tuned for updates, and good luck in battles!

releases.displayName: The Dawn’s Children are ready to fight! New features of the November update

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/96e5a3b4b21e876cab761cef1db55b98bcd76ed8.png"]

Hello, survivors! The “New Horizon” is ending, and the Dawn’s Children are ready to join the fight for the Oracle’s modules. While chasing Aris, Stahl has come across a besieged scientific facility that studies Ravager technology. Will he be able to negotiate with the leaders of the facility and learn crucial information on Aris’ path and tactics?

In any case, Stahl’s expedition discovers the new equipment developed by the Dawn’s Children, and we will tell you about his findings today. The first part of the blog focuses on the legendary engine, epic plasma autocannon, and frames of new shapes and sizes. Let’s dive in!

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This also applies to all visual materials.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/d4a8e7137488664ec5504879f27f676a1eb155f4.jpg"]
According to legends, Atlas is the name of a titan who holds up the sky. The Dawn’s Children deliberately chose it for their creation because it can carry more weight than any other engine.

The main feature of the “Atlas” is that it reduces the mass of all mounted weapons. Heavy weapons used in combination with hovers, for example, will no longer turn the vehicle into a slow hulk. Using heavy weapons with some movement parts will no longer be an inconvenience.

“Atlas” also has some unusual parameters: it possesses the highest bonus to the maximum speed of movement parts among all the engines, as well as a unique combination of tonnage, power, and maximum speed bonus. If you dreamt about a nimble hover that packs a punch of heavy weaponry and is not the slowest on the team, “Atlas” has you covered. Which weapon will you try out first?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/fe98d81a87832952e7cbd01877e3c12b26d1d5a2.jpg"]

The Dawn’s Children didn’t want to compromise between two types of weapons and took the best from each. “Ares” is a plasma autocannon with blast damage. Its projectiles have no ballistic trajectory, and overheating is replacing the charging mechanic. It makes it easier to target fast cars at a long distance, but you should be mindful of the weapon’s temperature if you don’t want it out of commission for too long.

“Ares” has unique features that help you control the overheating. After hitting an enemy, the heat from that shot goes down, and the farther the target, the greater the heat reduction. So the longer your shots, the longer your uninterrupted fire.
“Ares” is an energy weapon capable of delivering continuous fire on medium and long distances; fighting in close quarters is not its strong suit.
The next season will bring standard and lightweight frames of the following shapes and sizes:
5х4 frame;
4х2 corner frame (left and right);
2х3х2 curved frame (left and right).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/bbcde695577195c6da53e1ae1ce066261d25ae31.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/131e61a026ed5589e566bc7eed4dad899eb48a2b.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/f099c49282a552c408450bdc1fb755f99723ced3.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/f425bcc507f1f368c71b041009af02786fe33434.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/85180592712f62bd91bf254db6cf096303a0e6b7.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/6734483c6d0638c110adfe4c9f58e85569da5594.jpg"]
Please note that once the Battle Pass ends, the new frames will be available at the workbench in exchange for Engineer badges.
And this is just the beginning! The Dawn’s Children have many more high-tech parts on offer. The next developer blog entry will be released very soon. Stay tuned and good luck in battles!

Fixed a number of bugs relating to environment objects on various maps.
Updated the description of the “Master” cabin perk.
Improved the models of the mines, increasing their visibility.
Fixed a bug that caused the armoured car’s durability bar not to change when structural parts that increased the vehicle’s durability were destroyed.
Fixed the display of personal rating changes and the description in the results window for “Clan war: Leviathans”.
Fixed a bug that caused the “Snowfall” rocket launcher’s scope to not function correctly when the weapon was mounted vertically and the player attempted to aim upwards and to the side.
Fixed an uneven surface at the “Powerplant” location, which armoured cars could get stuck on.
Removed an obsolete requirement regarding clan roles from the “Clan war” description.
Made a number of improvements to enhance server and client stability.

releases.displayName: Compensation for the delay of the “New graphics” update

items.text: Hello, survivors! We recently had to postpone the release date of the “New graphics” update for technical reasons. We are grateful for your patience, and we would like to express our gratitude in the form of small bonuses for you!
Starting today and until October 21 inclusive, you can claim a gift when logging into the game, which contains 7 days of premium subscription. Moreover, the gift also has:
2 levels of the “New Horizon” season.
1 level of the “Oracle’s Echo” event.
Good luck in battles, and see you in the renewed Wasteland in the “New graphics” update!
You can download this and other artworks from the “Wallpapers” section on our official website.
Crossout team
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/ca9a9f55453874985813c79c0355ef0e3ce4adaf.png"]
Hello, survivors. Due to technical reasons, the release of the major October update has been rescheduled for October 22.

The previously announced events will be extended. This also applies to “Clan wars”, the original format of which will remain unchanged for another week. In addition, the current “Oracle’s echo” event will last until October 21 inclusive.
“Clan wars” will be unavailable from October 19 to October 25 due to switching to the new format after the release of the update.

The first season of the updated “Clan wars” begins on October 26. The initial rating will be formed based on the previous “Gauntlet of the survivors” season. You can find more details in our recent development blog entry.
We will take steps to provide compensation for the inconvenience and possible recent connection problems.
Good luck in battles!

releases.displayName: Planned balance changes of the October update

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/684cbe5a91e907f0826dae9fcd6bcaa328a2bed5.png"]
Hello, survivors! It’s time to find out what balance changes are coming out in the upcoming “New Graphics” update. Before we dive in, we would like to remind you that:
All the new features described in this news are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all.
Perk bonuses now only apply when the autonomous weapon is within a 100 meter radius of its owner.
Comment: the change makes leaving stationary autonomous weapons far away from the owner inefficient.
Acceleration reduced by 15%.
Enemy detection radius for the perk’s bonus reduced from 100 to 80 m.
Comment: high efficiency of the movement part.
Durability reduced from 1220 to 793 pts.
Mass reduced from 1024 to 819 kg.
The perk now additionally increases movement part protection by up to 90%, depending on speed.
Comment: the changes should reduce “Hyena’s” survivability in melee combat and increase it when driving at speeds close to maximum.
Projectile speed increased by 30%.
Comment: the change should improve the ease of use and damage dealing of the weapon.
Damage reduced by 10%.
The time after an explosion when the charge does not accumulate increased from 8 to 10 sec.
Comment: high efficiency of the weapon.
Durability reduced from 320 to 288 pts.
Mass reduced from 457 to 411 kg.
Damage taken by the shotgun increased by 50%.
Comment: the weapon’s survivability is too high. The change makes activating the shotgun an even riskier move, and players will need to time their shots more carefully in the heat of battle.
Perk projectile penetration ability bonus increased from 25% to 40%.
Perk charging time reduced from 1.2 to 1 sec.
Standard projectile impulse reduced by 15%.
Comment: low efficiency of the weapon. The changes should improve it when using the perk.
Durability reduced from 1267 to 950 pts.
Mass reduced from 2574 to 1930 kg.
Comment: “Thanatos’s” parameters were slightly high considering its model and compared to other generators.
The update featuring the new graphics and many other changes is coming on October 15. See you then!

releases.displayName: Eclipse is coming! Features of the major June update. Part 3

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/a251a3c6160e0c013bc0a1f1ef7b76db00f1fc9e.png"]
Part 1
Part 2

Hello, survivors! Let’s continue exploring the new features of the upcoming season. In part three, we’ll cover the epic frontal wheel, the legendary shotgun, details on the new faction, new brawls and old brawls (the return of “Squad battle”!)… There’s also mention of some situational weather effect that impacts combat. Let’s dive in!

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This also applies to all visual materials.

notes.title: New faction in the Wasteland: The Eclipse

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/56a5d35903761b568c71cb7f37665c07052a13bf.png"]

Aris’s attempt to merge the Oracle’s fragments led to the emergence of a new faction, and the energy blast he released forced the Khaganate and the Engineers to retreat. In the commotion, Aris had vanished…

So who exactly are the “Eclipse”? They are former operatives of international renown, the best of the best soldiers whose bodies have undergone implantation and various forms of mechanisation, yet they have not lost their human minds or willpower. Now they are the most advanced and technologically sophisticated group in the Valley. The “Eclipse” biorobots have only one goal: to protect the Oracle at any cost. Are you ready to help them?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/f7a70d707659440e6a369ed12bb126b4a00102dd.png"]

Looking at this technological marvel, one wants to scream, “Where are they?!” The Lunatics are going to be sad that there’s nothing explosive in the new movement part, although it has the ability to perform a 180-degree turn, which does hint at having an explosive temper.

It would be interesting to count all the times when players will exclaim, “What a twist!” when you activate this new feature. The “Wayfarer” perk turns the armoured car in the direction the camera is facing, whether by 45, 90, or 180 degrees. You can even make a dramatic screeching stop on your armoured bike, just like Kaneda. In short, the new movement part offers a ton of tactical possibilities! Including the ability to shock everyone around you.
P.S. How many references do you want in this devblog entry? Yes.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/a958b40f8e6a25297c6ef6cc46634fb8c4a3b594.png"]

Time for the final key part of the new season. It’s already clear that “Eclipse” focuses on fast and deadly strikes, followed by the successful withdrawal of their biomechanical bodies from the battle. The new shotgun fits this playstyle perfectly, but its strength lies not only in its rapid-fire blasts against enemy armoured cars. You could say that it is, in fact, an armoured car itself.

What’s that box at its base? The thing is, while “Extremum” isn’t busy destroying enemies, it stays inside this protective container, but as soon as you open fire, the shotgun pops out like a jack-in-the-box. This is the first weapon in Crossout that has variable dimensions, so to speak. It’s a good thing the new weapon overheats quickly (in its case, that’s actually a plus), so you won’t have to keep the shotgun in a vulnerable open position for long. Of course, that doesn’t mean it deals little damage. It just does it very quickly, because while the “Extremum” isn't firing, it builds up a charge that increases its rate of fire for the next burst.

notes.title: Structural parts of the new season

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/2bb5f937845b3d362898606367d6880b735e9945.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/1f8dea74ef444850e1f6337ad78e9e1fdd96915e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/9423aa7adaf32b50b67dc3e31c94251b938a264f.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/7ce4a967358b8a20bd4b73fc470961f2b871ff83.png"]
Are the old-timers here? We hope you’ll let us know if you’re still around. The old favourite “Squad battle” is back! Three teams of four survivors and a shrinking sandstorm. You know what to do.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/eb936b6c5290365a1ef2c3f3e4c2c488da6f4495.jpg"]

The update will bring two new brawls: “Short circuit” and “Elimination” protocol. “Short circuit” is an asymmetrical mode where one team of survivors must defend generators until the progress bar reaches 100%, while the other team must try to destroy those generators.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/709ffbf38446c10ec65c61efcd67c291e78fb179.jpg"]

Welcome to the training grounds of the “Eclipse” pathfinders! The “Elimination” protocol brawl is a four-player match where each player receives a secret contract to kill a specific opponent, knowing only the number of hunters that are after themself. To maintain cover, two AI decoys of each player with the same name and armoured car roam the map, but these decoys do not fire and cannot use active modules. The players’ objective is to impersonate these decoys and identify the real target among the identical vehicles, following certain rules:
Mindless shooting is not beneficial. First, carefully study the target and make sure it’s not an AI player, and only then shoot;

Skillfully use social camouflage skills. Pretend to be a simple AI armoured car driving around and confuse the players hunting you. You can also outmaneuver and destroy the hunters to earn extra points;
And remember: all players (including yourself!) can be destroyed with a single shot.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/de0c98417925752bc54d88a8550f9ebd62dc3b95.jpg"]

Also, the “Test prototypes” brawl will begin once again at the start of the new season. It is a good way to test out new parts. Finally, “For the Emperor!” brawl will return, as well as the finale of the “Operation” series, where you’ll once again be able to face off against the mad scientist.

Out of the blue, the sandstorm from “Squad battle” breaks out of the brawl and disrupts the Valley’s daily routine. This weather event adds variety to battles for a limited time. Most maps in the “Get the scrap metal!”, “Get the wires!” and “Get the batteries!” missions will have a chance of a sandstorm event triggering at a random moment! Its form (circular or in the shape of a “wall”) will depend on the battle mode, such as “Assault” or “Domination”.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/153a6c0fb03fa7ecdc592302b780ab1d6b4cc498.jpg"]
[p align="center"]***

This blog entry concludes the series of publications about the new season, and you will be able to learn more about all the rewards and features of the season from our livestream next week. Stay tuned and good luck in battles!

releases.displayName: New faction is coming! Features of the major June update. Part 2

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/591a9923233dc02c001caf04f78b0ae847d80096.png"]
Part 1
Hello, survivors! Let’s continue exploring the new features of the upcoming season. In this part, we’ll talk about the legendary cabin and cannon. Let’s check out the details!

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This also applies to all visual materials.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/74f6baf6d0b59f80ffd5ae968496d78e2831fa01.png"]

The lightness of the new cabin provides the speed and manoeuvrability essential for delivering swift and deadly strikes against your opponents, combined with a seemingly concealed autonomous assistant.

Picture this: in the heat of battle, you have picked your next victim, and your new cabin carries a drone that is waiting only for your command to strike. When activated, this vigilant companion will fly around you and apply the penetrability effect to the parts of the enemy you have selected. The drone itself is surrounded with an electric shield. The icing on the high-tech cake is that when the drone is activated, your chosen enemy will take more damage but only from you. Don’t forget to cast such a “curse” on your opponents while your loyal drone will draw their attention to itself, giving you more precious time.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/3e6570e871a0be266ee6416199d2cbd90ac33d82.png"]

It’s so great that the mechanics of the new faction allow you to ignore a bunch of enemy structural parts and fire a powerful cannon shell right in their cabin. With this new cannon, you can actually pull this off.

Two different projectiles will help you in both dealing significant damage and exposing vulnerable points. If you want to apply the new penetrability effect to the enemy’s parts, you can shoot a bomb projectile which sticks to the enemy car and explodes with a short delay, applying the effect to the impacted parts (the blast itself deals minor damage as well). The other projectile is a standard cannon shot, powerful and dealing considerable damage. Playing this combination in the heat of battle may be challenging, but if you manage to apply the effect and hit important parts, what could be the downside? And one more thing: if the sticky shell successfully hits the enemy, the weapon’s reload speed increases. Sweet!
This time, there are standard and heavy frames in the following sizes: 3x8, 3x6, as well as a 6x2x1 nodal frame.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/dbe3f442307f3f23711680fecfbeb3f6742945d9.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/09807c43e4386b59a56b22674397965a9d03b26f.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/72aef2398e1ca6554081cf6997cfc8f5c4877d76.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/427bf44c9f28d1b9f86fbb8f6a43735438df22b5.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/1281738ed18b80669b1164eac535fee8a5f95e56.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/0a543b3584021cc05e9677ff76a9dbcfea987b7d.png"]
Please note that you will be able to get the new frames for Engineer badges on the workbench.
And with that we are approaching the next devblog entry, which we plan to release soon. Stay tuned.

releases.displayName: New faction is coming! Features of the major June update. Part 1

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/7645af4aaecadf2cd9a919e1ac2fb4d939c4079e.png"]

Hello, survivors! The “Playing with fire” season is coming to an end. The Engineers, Lunatics, and Ravagers have pushed the line and awakened the Oracle’s defence mechanism, which turned out to be a whole new faction. We will talk more about the new force coming to the Wasteland in the upcoming entries; for now, we would only like to say that it’s the most technologically advanced and powerful group the Valley has ever seen. We invite you to speculate on the new faction in the comments and see who can guess more about them judging by their parts described below.
This time we’ll tell you about the new legendary module and weapon that will turn you into stealthy, deadly, and untraceable assassins. Let’s dive in!

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This also applies to all visual materials.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/dadd3611fe3d382a145209f1ba1274c01dd1482f.png"]

The new faction is proficient at stealth and is more than happy to launch surprise attacks at the most inopportune moments for their enemies. The new legendary weapon is perfect for those who love to play sneakily. It fires a burst of projectiles that deal melee damage and also has an alternative firing mode with horizontal spread, launching all projectiles simultaneously.

The key component of using the new weapon efficiently is skillful stealth. While the armoured car is invisible, the weapon’s damage increases every second until it reaches the maximum value. The damage bonus activates upon firing or exiting invisibility and lasts for a short time. Additionally, firing this weapon breaks invisibility with a slight delay rather than immediately, providing valuable time for further combat maneuvers.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/26fbd83b0542c097aed8d50845cf1d5bd8692261.png"]

The new faction has several parts with a new unique mechanic. The effect works similarly to heating or freezing: it builds up over time and resets. But unlike the thermal effects, it makes the parts penetrable. The new module with power nodes utilizes this mechanic. Whatever may it be called?

When the module is activated, all parts attached to the power nodes gain the penetrability effect for a certain amount of time. The module also applies the effect to itself. This feature will improve the survivability of the armoured car’s critical parts when assembled correctly. The module also has a passive reload speed bonus, which encourages you to move away from enemies after using it so you can reload faster and return to battle.

We remind you that all the new features described in this news are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. You can see all the planned changes in more detail on the special testing server.

items.text: If you have already participated in testing on a special server, then it will be enough to start the Launcher from the folder with the test client and wait for the update to complete.

releases.displayName: Mad fire at the door! New features of the major February update. Part 3

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/a2b9714053ab489a18eeea6f9aef0559276581d6.png"]
Part 1
Part 2
Hello, survivors! Let’s continue learning about the new features of the upcoming season. In the third part, we’ll talk about the legendary disk launcher and epic track. Let’s dive in!

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This also applies to all visual materials.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/adb4e145ac14c4056ce8040ef301e3e02b316c00.jpg"]

We think many would agree that playing as a “rogue” has always brought its own unique fun to any game. Applying the “bleeding” effect or poisons to an enemy and then watching their health bar melt away is a special kind of pleasure in virtual battles. The Lunatics have crafted a disk launcher with blades that do roughly the same thing to the enemy. For greater effect, you need to choose the spot with maximum concentration of parts in the enemy build.

The disk itself attaches to the enemy and begins to slowly cut through their parts, dealing periodic damage upon contact. When contact with the parts is lost or the disk’s active time ends, the projectile explodes, but the force of the explosion depends on the amount of periodic damage inflicted. In short, if you fail to cut through a bunch of parts, a relatively strong explosion will somewhat compensate for the failure, and if you manage to cut the enemy to pieces, then everything is fine, and you don’t need the explosion. It is important to know that the disk does not penetrate weapons, movement parts, or the cabin, and the enemy’s allies can shoot down the disk and disrupt your plans.

The disk launcher perk is the cherry on top of your opponents’ suffering. As it deals periodic damage, the disk launcher accumulates up to five charges. Each charge increases the periodic damage of the next disk. The rate at which charges accumulate depends on the number of parts in contact with the disk and the penetration speed of the projectile. To be honest, we didn’t expect the Lunatics to create something so complex. That doesn’t mean we think they’re “thoughtless”! Not at all.

Our conversation about the parts of the new season concludes with the new epic track from the Lunatics. As you can see in the image above, this new movement part has a BIG front roller with a bunch of blades in it. Have you guessed what they’re for? Come on, it’s the Lunatics we’re talking about.

The new track is perfect for smashing into enemies at high speed. When you reach 45 km/h, the BIG front roller starts dealing damage when it hits an enemy. This damage increases as you gather speed, up to 90 km/h. So, just speed up and smash into the enemy. It hurts, yeah.

notes.title: Structural parts of the new season

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/3f28f029550fb601dd3ede741e79fe14ef7ab263.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/804feedc28c5fbf9693763727735d352103054ac.jpg"]

The next update will also bring back some familiar brawls, namely the “At gunpoint” (now not just with the first person view, but with a view from the cabin itself. We assembled the cabins specifically for this mode!), “Ice and Fire,” and “Test prototypes,” in which you can once again try out the new season’s parts.

There will also be a rookie among the veterans: the new “Precious driver” brawl. It’s like the “Developer hunt”, only without the developers. One player will be randomly selected from each team. The task of that player is to defeat as many enemies as possible, because they get more points than the others, but the risk is that the enemy will also get a lot of points for destroying the chosen player. So you need to protect your team’s precious driver and hunt down the enemy one. The team that scores the most points wins. Note that this is a mode without respawns, and you can always win by simply killing all your opponents, but it is still more profitable to build your strategy around the chosen player.
With the launch of the new season we will also release unscheduled balance changes for the following parts:

notes.title: Changed the parameters of the new blast damage mechanics

items.text: The total amount of fragments reduced by 25%.
Damage is now reduced faster as you move away from the center of the explosion, and is now 60% at the border of the radius (instead of 80% before).
Now the perk charges after 0.8 sec. (instead of 0.6 sec. before).
Bonus to damage from the perk reduced by 17%.
The range of the shot with the active perk is increased by 60% (instead of 75% before).

Comment about both parts: the following weapons’ additional “firing” modes began to significantly stand out in ranked modes, so we decided to reduce their efficiency outside of the scheduled balance changes. The change to the “Breaker” partially mitigates its previous reinforcement. In the case of the “Corax”, the changes adjust the parameters of the new blast damage mechanics.
[p align="center"]***

This blog entry concludes the series of publications about the new season, and you will be able to learn more about all the rewards and features of the season from our livestream next week. Stay tuned and good luck in battles!
P.S. The next update, coming in March, will have new content that has never been seen before in Crossout. Keep a close eye on our social media starting at the end of February.

releases.displayName: Mad fire at the door! New features of the major February update. Part 2

items.text: Part 1
Hello, survivors! Let’s continue learning about the new features of the upcoming season. In this part, we’ll talk about the legendary rocket launcher and engine. Let’s dive in!

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This also applies to all visual materials.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/44e1fcbf00436992dd394f45e70a901900e75d79.jpg"]

What kind of Firestarters season would it be without incendiary weapons? No matter what anyone says, Firestarters love the smell of napalm not only in the morning, but at any time of day and night. The faction has created the first rapid-fire artillery in the Wasteland, which fires a continuous stream of rockets. Wow!

The new weapon fires fast projectiles that fly on a plunging trajectory. The rocket launcher’s perk works as follows: after four hits on an enemy from a distance of 30 at least meters, the rocket launcher fires an amplified incendiary projectile. If this projectile does not hit the enemy, a puddle of fire appears at the point of explosion, which damages all targets and heats them up. If the special projectile hits the enemy, it heats up their parts.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/2c713bc4f3ce9d5faee55aff16bdd5c0b82b1b8f.jpg"]
The new Firestarters’ engine does not shoot fire, but it has a lot to offer in return. The main thing when using it is not to stop. Preferably ever.

When maintaining a certain percentage of the armoured car’s maximum speed for several seconds, the engine accumulates a bonus. When any module or autonomous weapon is activated, with the exception of sentry drones, this bonus significantly reduces their reload time. It reduces it so much that the module can be used almost twice in a row. This bonus works on the first activated module or autonomous weapon, or when activated on a single weapon group. So think about it.

releases.displayName: Mad fire at the door! New features of the major February update. Part 1

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/235b0a2f4a82397bb8c7be45179ca9eca6755fb9.png"]

Hello, survivors! The “Forced measure” season is coming to an end. The joint attack of the Lunatics and Engineers on Aris has borne fruit. Now the Ravagers’ enemies know where to find the key component necessary for Aris’s plan. The signal sent by Stahl is still online, so the Lunatics and Firestarters are setting out to find answers to very important questions.

Khaganate is once again at the center of the season, so get ready to use crazy fiery weapons and modules. In the first part of the entry, we’ll talk about the legendary medium cabin and melee weapons, as well as take a look at the new frame sizes. Let’s dive in!

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This also applies to all visual materials.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/9e7ec54c820a9cd67461cca13fc4355fc0a7d1b1.png"]

It’s been a while since we had a Firestarters’ season. In the first entry, we’ll take a closer look at the new medium cabin from the connoisseurs of the flames. Although this cabin in particular is designed to help you cool down faster and catch your breath in the heat of battle. Even the Firestarters need to unwind sometimes.

The cabin passively increases the reload speed and cooldown rate of weapons. It also accumulates up to ten charges as damage is dealt with any weapon. When the perk is activated, the reload and cooldown rates are further increased for each accumulated charge for a certain period of time. The best thing is that the accumulated charges are not spent. Firestarters crafted the first cabin in the Wasteland that improves its active perk for the whole duration of a battle.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/d915aaf54c8efb104725187ba033aaeae9403295.png"]

Do you know what a railroad wheelset is? You’re about to find out. It sounds like something heavy and very painful. You definitely don’t want one of those things flying towards your cabin. But what about launching one yourself? In short, the Lunatics are true to form.
The weapon fires special physical objects, railroad wheelsets, that inflict ram damage upon impact. Yes, that’s not a typo. Ram damage from a distance. Finally! Need we say more?

But that wasn’t enough for the Lunatics. The new weapon can also be used at melee range. Just drive up close to an enemy and start hitting them. However, it’s not that simple. While the wheelset is hitting an opponent, its durability reduces and its damage in projectile form goes down. If you use it as a melee weapon for a long time, you can completely grind down the projectile, and the weapon will go into reload mode. To melee or not to melee? That is the question.
This time, we have standard and heavy frames for you in the following sizes: 3x4, 3x6, as well as a nodal frame 8х2х4.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/2499d4002e026f11dbe6f2098adc32533178dcca.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/767571437f5fa1fb796b7b06c6797ce5ed85ec35.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/80866b23ffc3c032e0af8edf6905dd3cd9fe91c8.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/77c45b6d3615abcfa33d29e28831426616e51770.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/63771aa46b6e18f6dbcebd9879fd2689ce7c66be.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/50463cac62561240f4c4ae71020ae71734995a81.jpg"]
Please note that after the season ends, you will be able to get the new frames at a workbench for Engineer badges.
And this is only the beginning! The fire will light the way to the next blog entry, which will be here soon. Stay tuned.

Hello, survivors! This is the final entry about the new features of the upcoming season. In this part, we’ll talk about the legendary shotgun and new epic movement part, an air cushion! Let’s dive in.

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This applies not only to information about possible unique features of new parts, but also to the appearance of the parts themselves.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/b61b4782f4f4cb4a5cfcece6e64df9003a87a42d.png"]
Do you like the “Arothron” and “Parser”? The Lunatics decided to create their own version of a long-range shotgun and came up with something that literally shreds enemy cars to pieces.

The new shotgun has a built-in shredder, which grinds up various scrap metal (just don’t ask the Lunatics where they got it from...) and fires a cluster of eight pellets with a wide spread. As it fires the “Shredder’s” rate of fire increases.

The weapon perk works when shooting at a distance. The farther away the enemy is, the stronger your shots will be. For every 1 meter to the target, the damage of the “Shredder” will increase by 5%. Sounds dangerous.

notes.title: Epic movement part: “MVP Torpedo” air cushion

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/15bc00eb9a539596ffa48b04bf1cab8736dbd9aa.png"]
You couldn’t even tell that the Engineers invented something that can be used as a movement part. But this cushion isn’t called a torpedo for nothing!

The new movement part offers particularly smooth movement across the Valley. However, its movement direction is not tied to the camera, and one of the mechanical features to consider is that if you activate the handbrake while driving, the “MVP Torpedo” reduces the strafe speed of the armoured car rather than stopping it completely.

The movement part perk makes the armoured car sturdy at high speeds. Starting at 80 km/h, the “MVP Torpedo” increases the damage protection of the armoured car. The maximum bonus of 35% damage protection is accumulated at 115 km/h.

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/4d4ba4bfb7c232bf2ffb9854437e0d777b456e3f.png"]
Part 2
Hello, survivors! Let’s continue learning about the new features of the upcoming season. In this part, we’ll talk about the legendary machine gun and light cabin. Let’s dive in!

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This applies not only to information about possible unique features of new parts, but also to the appearance of the parts themselves.
The combined Battle pass of two factions could not do without a hybrid weapon, which embodies the union of discipline and madness. A machine gun and a grenade launcher in one package!

The “Hybrid” has two firing modes, which can be switched by double-clicking the fire button. In the first mode, the new weapon rains machine gun fire on the enemies, and in the second mode, it launches grenades that attach to the target and explode after a short period of time.

The “Hybrid’s” perk encourages using one mode to enhance the other. When hitting an enemy at a distance of 50 meters in machine gun mode, the perk accumulates a bonus that increases the explosion radius for grenades in the second mode. When firing grenades in the second mode, the perk accumulates a bonus to machine gun damage for each enemy with an attached grenade. Skillful use of the two modes is the key to unlocking the full potential of the “Hybrid”.
Note that all these bonuses are not permanent. They only last for 10 seconds after firing.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/ac45e8a9519c46d92ee8b3ac74c21205ba28f793.png"]
Remember “Catalina”? The Engineers sure do, and they felt that it hasn’t reached its final form. “Dolores” is the culmination of the idea behind “Catalina”.

You are familiar with the basic mechanics of the cabin and its perk. When mounted on an armoured car, it reduces all weapon damage by 20%, and when damage is dealt to enemies, the cabin increases weapon damage by 8% up to 10 times.

Additionally, the “Dolores” perk also increases weapon damage by 15% after the delay for receiving the next charge ends, but this bonus only works until that charge is received. Such a surge of power can become decisive in battle.

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/fda6bd6241e93c486b96d6b91ad591cb151a7576.png"]

Hello, survivors! The “Wolfpack” season is coming to an end. The battle between Steppenwolfs and the Ravagers has led to tragic consequences, and Ivy XO is forced to make a desperate decision: ally with the Khaganate. Now, the Engineers will face the threat of Aris and his Ravagers together with the Lunatics!

This unexpected alliance led to the creation of many unique weapons and modules. Anything to defeat the machines. The first blog entry will focus on the epic charge booster and the legendary crossbow, as well as new frame sizes. Let’s dive in!

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This applies not only to information about possible unique features of new parts, but also to the appearance of the parts themselves.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/f283bd3b1f2d7b38cad45e7abcdbf3c1bad066ff.png"]

A legendary continuation of the Lunatics’ “Varun”. “Corax” fires heavy projectiles, and if you maintain a certain shooting rhythm, they can send any enemy back to their garage to ponder redesigning their armoured car.

The rhythmic shooting mechanic of the crossbow is similar to its predecessor. You can triple your damage output if you maintain the rate of fire, making the weapon perfect for collected and precise shooters.

However, you don’t always have to follow the fire rate pattern. In that case, the “Corax” will reveal its second forte: the projectile will stick to an enemy’s armour and explode after a moment, showering the target in deadly fragments. First, soften up the enemy with an explosion, and then rhythmically deal damage to them until only a wreckage is left. The basic penetration ability of the weapon exceeds 100%, and will help you in that process. This is a first in the Valley.
P.S. Another explosive crossbow in the Wasteland. makes you wonder, who is really more consistent, the Engineers or the Lunatics…
The Engineers acted as good partners and created a module that synergizes well with charging weapons. A great companion piece for “Corax”!

The “Starter” provides you with a much-needed help in starting your car in winter 20% reduction of shot charging time and barrel spool-up time! This is quite a boost, so there’s a limit of one module per build.
When the Dawn’s Children found out about the “Starter”, they felt like it might be a strong rival to their “Power unit”. So the new module can’t be used with plasma emitters. Diplomacy wins.
This time, there are new standard and heavy frames in sizes 1x7 and 2x7, as well as an L-shaped frame 6×4×1.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/7c4b54b0d27304542bdea2a465306121f954d025.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/f9f97752016e3cc0ef413b4a860be4def924e492.png"]

Please note that after the season ends, you will be able to get the new frames at a workbench for Engineer badges.
And this is only the beginning! See you in the next entry, coming very soon. Stay tuned.

releases.displayName: Steppenwolfs are ready for battle. New features of the major August update

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/e0834a7f4525cf8e686af0a090f065c1444980ff.png"]

Hello, survivors! This entry concludes the series of posts about the upcoming Steppenwolfs season. In this part, we’ll talk about the legendary grenade launcher and artillery minelayer, as well as the new relic weapon. Let’s dive in!

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This applies not only to information about possible unique features of new parts, but also to the appearance of the parts themselves
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/74b4239edaf7490790d2d1c83ed39462cc048298.jpg"]
You may have noticed quite a famous abbreviation in the name of the weapon, and it speaks for itself. The Steppenwolfs have made an old dream of every raider in the Wasteland a reality.

“Darling” fires a jet grenade that flies on a straight trajectory. If the projectile has travelled some distance on the way to the target, it jettisons a stage and accelerates, like a rocket. When such a projectile hits an enemy, its explosive energy travels along the movement trajectory and penetrates parts. It’s a very powerful weapon for such a cute name.

You may say that it’s hard to be precise with a grenade launcher, and it’s true. Especially because the projectile has different speeds because of its two phases. But rest assured, the result is worth the effort.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/9b6935a2410271ed6b9c7a2aa53d1d4c6180aaa2.jpg"]

An unusual new device brought to you by the Steppenwolfs. There were a lot of comments expressing a burning desire of the survivors to have a new artillery weapon. And despite the “Squall” being classified as a “minelayer”, it actually marks a spot for a wide-radius airstrike with its small mines!

“Squall” fires a mine that flies on a plunging trajectory to the targeted spot. While the mine is active, the surrounding area is under constant rocket fire. The enemy can destroy the mine. In this case, the “Squall” speeds up its reloading by 50%. Of course, the barrage of rockets is not endless. The mine will deactivate on its own after some time.

The weapon was created primarily to control the battlefield and skillfully redirect enemy movement. But if a stray rocket hits an opponent, it’s even better, isn’t it? An additional bonus is that the “Squall” consumes little energy. Unfortunately, you can’t install several weapons at the same time. Steppenwolfs honor the laws of fair warfare, so you can’t have more than two at a time.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/8a4caadd8f3e75241c3ffe20ac29dac5b3da6b8c.jpg"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/6a8797e2cac61e17b7335dff95ba3886338bd277.jpg"]

Bombastic greetings from the Nomads! They have an explosive gift for you. The new relic is the crown jewel of the “Retcher” branch. Never before has it been so much fun to wreak havoc and destruction in Crossout!

The perk works as follows: when you hit a target from a distance, the weapon accumulates charges. Each charge increases the damage of one grenade. So the number of charges you have is equal to the number of amplified grenades you can launch. It’s important to note that the accumulated charges can only be spent after the grenade launcher has completely cooled down.

After reading this, you may have a question: is there a limit to the number of charges that can be accumulated with the new relic weapon? The answer is basically no. So, is it an uncontrollable machine of death, then? What else did you expect? The relic version of “Retcher” must live up to the reputation of its predecessor.
P.S. Perhaps, there is a limit to the number of charges, after all. Will there ever be someone to reach it?
Please note that the relic weapon is not part of the Battle Pass
[p align="center"]***

Finally, we would like to mention that an unusual brawl will be available in the update. You will have to complete several classic PvE raids, but this time your enemies will be piloting armoured aircraft! By the way, you can also join this “expedition” on flying beauty.

This entry concludes our series of publications about the new season. You can find out more about all the rewards and new features during our traditional pre-update livestream, which will take place next week. Stay tuned for more news and good luck in battles!

releases.displayName: Steppenwolfs are ready for battle. New features of the major August update

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/e071e0b1a062070ce2f4c1ed74961aca50ce68c6.png"]
Hello, survivors! Let’s continue to learn about the new features of the upcoming Steppenwolfs season. In this entry, we’ll talk about the legendary revolver and rocket launcher. Let’s dive in!

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This applies not only to information about possible unique features of new parts, but also to the appearance of the parts themselves.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/2ab80afdc2129557f15515d0704b598201ae66c3.png"]

Everything in life has two sides. Take revolvers, for example. Their good side is that you can fire many powerful shots in a short period of time. Their bad side is the long reload time. It’s especially frustrating when you didn’t use up the entire cylinder at once, but still have to reload to regain the full firepower. Then you’re basically wasting ammo. But the Steppenwolfs have a solution for both drawbacks.

The new revolver has three projectiles in the cylinder, but the trick is that it can be loaded without ejecting unused ammo. Fired one or two shots out of three possible? You can add ammo without completely emptying the cylinder. Just be careful: each subsequent round loads slower than the previous one. Loading one of three doesn’t take long, but two of three is more time-consuming. And if all three projectiles are used, the revolver goes into a full and slow reload.

The revolver’s perk reduces the time for both full and partial reloads if you are the most accurate shooter in the Wasteland. One hit on an opponent gives you one charge. Each charge increases the speed of all types of reloads. If you miss, you lose one charge.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/b3d128efc22516c11ddec4de23141dc1a82a013a.png"]
The motto of the new Steppenwolfs’ legendary rocket launcher is simple and to the point: more rockets is better than less rockets. Nice and sweet.

The shooting mechanics are the same as for other course rocket launchers. The perk makes it so that if more than half of the rockets in a salvo hit the enemy from a certain distance, the number of rockets in the next salvo will increase. If only half of the rockets (or less) hit the enemy, the weapon loses one bonus charge. Simply put, if you often hit with most of the rockets, you will have a lot of rockets. It is advisable not to miss.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/44a8ac6405ba668fc49422f5fa87acb46890068c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/a870cd35db10eceb3c878123e452526bfebbbd90.png"]
That’s all for now. See you in the next entry, coming soon. Stay tuned

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/7e6d1e936adae4d8930cc22cb48c033fb668d4e5.png"]

Hello, survivors! The “Rogue mind” season is coming to an end. Wade has managed to escape Aris and ended up in your garage, and the Ravagers have gathered power with the help of new parts. However, this attracted the Brotherhood’s attention: the military organization is not very fond of the machines getting stronger. Steppenwolfs have assembled their best squads and set out to make a surprise attack and stop the Ravagers.

The wolves had to acquire new modules to counter the new technology of the Ravagers. The first blog entry will be about their new legendary medium cabin and epic frontal wheel, as well as various frames of different sizes. Let’s dive in!

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This applies not only to information about possible unique features of new parts, but also to the appearance of the parts themselves.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/7edaf8bd60410eb5c887da986c9f010e8918af57.jpg"]

The Steppenwolfs’ machines are famous for their smart design that allows for almost anything to be transported. Their cabins are very different from Syndicate’s small light cabins, for instance. The new medium cabin is capable of enhancing the explosive potential of ammunition and saving the driver from worrying about the finite nature of ammo packs.

As any weapon deals damage, the cabin’s perk accumulates charges up to a certain number. When activated, it increases the blast radius of the projectiles and also stops using ammunition when firing. The duration of the perk depends on the number of accumulated charges.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26076615/651818fd76ba3ca40fa68cb4cca6324543d77bab.jpg"]

There’s something special and cool about the frontal wheels. They are just like regular wheels but... Frontal! And the word “front” is also very dear to the Steppenwolfs, so the ruthless warriors have prepared a new addition to the technological branch of these movement parts.

The new wheel increases the maximum speed of the armoured vehicle, as well as its reverse speed and power, if there are no enemies within a certain radius. Each enemy within the radius reduces the bonuses until they are completely lost.

notes.title: New frames of the upcoming season

items.text: This time, you can expect new standard and heavy frames of the following sizes: 5x1, 5x3, and an L-shaped 5x3 frame.

releases.displayName: Ravagers around the corner. New features of the major June update. Part 3

items.text: Part 1
Part 2
Hello, survivors! This is the last entry on the upcoming Ravagers season. Today, we will talk about the new legendary energy weapon, new ammunition, and other exciting features of the update.

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This applies not only to information about possible unique features of new parts, but also to the appearance of the parts themselves.
Last year, the Ravagers brought us the unusual “Morta”. This time, the faction also has a unique energy weapon with a peculiar mechanic.
The new weapon fires two projectiles that fly on a spiral trajectory, similar to the “Waltz” projectiles. There is an electric link effect between the projectiles.

The trick is that if there are another two projectiles within a certain radius from the first two, launched by a second copy of the weapon by the same player, the energy projectiles will merge into a huge ball of lightning that slowly floats forward and deals damage to nearby enemies, gradually slowing down. This lightning ball explodes upon hit or when its durability is depleted. And if the projectiles get destroyed before they merge, the weapon reloads faster for the next shot.

The time has come. The Ravagers have created the first legendary ammunition in the game. Thanks to the advanced technology, it can keep your supply full by taking from those who don’t need ammo anymore.

The perk of the module is charged when there are wreckages within a certain radius. When the charge is full, it immediately resets and restores the ammunition of each weapon by a certain percentage from the initial passive increase it provided. Note that this initial increase is a little lower than the epic ammunition modules, but this is made up for by the perk and the low mass.

The module won’t restore ammo above the maximum value, and won’t charge up if all your weapons have full ammo reserves. We recommend that you protect the ammunition module, since it will disable your weapons for a short time if it gets destroyed.

notes.title: Other new features and important events

items.text: The next update will increase the involvement of survivors in the storyline of the Crossout world. Current news from the Wasteland will literally be in every player’s garage. And we’re not just talking about the short story page inside the game. Keep a close eye on your garages next week. With the release of the update, you will have a guest.
We also tried to make more changes in response to your requests and suggestions. We would like to thank you for the feedback, and for helping to make the game better!
Furthermore, we would also like to mention the update of the list of available maps for clan competitive modes, which you can learn about here.
The new Ravagers Battle Pass will contain a new type of reward that will allow you to taunt destroyed opponents. The Wasteland is becoming more toxic!

As you know, the late May/early June is the time when we celebrate the anniversary of Crossout’s first public testing. This year is the 10th anniversary! Expect a special news article next week, where we will tell you more about the celebrations and, of course, the gifts we prepared.

This entry concludes the series of posts about the new season, and you can find out about all the rewards and new features on our livestream before the update, which will take place next week. Stay tuned and good luck in battles!

releases.displayName: Ravagers around the corner. New features of the major June update. Part 2

items.text: Part 1

Hello, survivors! Let’s continue to learn about the new features of the upcoming Ravagers season. In this entry, we’ll talk about the legendary pulse accelerator and the eerie epic movement part consisting of many legs. Let’s dive in!

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This applies not only to information about possible unique features of new parts, but also to the appearance of the parts themselves.

In the first entry, we told you about the light legendary cabin that is perfect for long-range fire. The Ravagers have prepared a suitable weapon for it, which will allow you to wreak chaos and destruction without getting close to your opponents.
To activate the accelerator’s perk, you need to hit enemies twice in a row from a long distance. After that, the weapon’s projectile is replaced with a special one.

When it hits, this special projectile attaches itself to the enemy and periodically damages all enemy cabins within a certain radius. Note that if the cabin has 25% durability or less, it will not receive periodic damage.
After the damage phase, enemies within the radius will no longer see other players on their radar for a period of time.

It’s a shame when you’re using “ML 200” or any other legs, and one gets destroyed in battle. You have to hobble along and suffer until the end (which is not always a victory). The Ravagers have created a unique movement part that can keep your build firmly on its feet even after a fierce firefight.

One copy of the new movement part has two legs. That’s why a lot of them on a build may remind you of a centipede. The key feature is regenerating durability after a certain amount is lost. For example, if the movement part absorbs some damage, then only one leg will be disabled, while the second one will continue to function. After a while, the disabled leg regenerates and you can use it again.
Of course, if you lose both legs, you will fall to the ground. But after a while, the legs will regenerate, and you will be able to walk again and scare every arachnophobe you meet.

notes.title: Structural parts of the upcoming season

items.text: That’s all for now. See you in the last entry, coming soon. Stay tuned.

releases.displayName: Ravagers around the corner. New features of the major June update. Part 1

items.text: Hello, survivors! “The New Frontier” season is about to end. All this time, the Ravagers and their leader Aris have been experimenting in the depths of the “Cradle of mind”. Thanks to the protection of the Founders, they were able to make significant progress towards awakening the new mind. Nobody has realized yet how it will affect the balance of forces in the Wasteland.

The Ravagers return to the Valley with a bunch of unusual weapons and modules. This first devblog entry will talk about the new legendary light cabin and the new shotgun, as well as new sizes of frames. Let’s dive in!

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This applies not only to information about possible unique features of new parts, but also to the appearance of the parts themselves.

The Ravagers have developed an interesting light cabin that is perfect for those who like precise shooting at long distance. Thanks to its features, you will be able to make powerful shots at distant enemies, and easily change your position if you get spotted using the high maximum speed of the cabin.

The cabin passively increases the penetration ability of weapons. The perk is accumulated with medium to long range hits. After a full charge of perk, you can activate it and temporarily increase the penetration ability of your weapons even more. So much so that this is the first cabin in the game that will allow you to raise the penetration ability of your weapons above 100%!
This cabin would work best with some sort of sniper weapon. Who knows, maybe the Ravagers will provide something suitable. We’ll see in the next blog entry…

A nod to those who love spears. The Ravagers decided to add an explosive twist to the list of new features of the update. The legendary shotgun continues the “Gremlin’s” technology branch. You can probably guess its perk from the start of this paragraph.

The shotgun has an explosive at the end of its barrel. Its mechanics are similar to explosive spears. In order to charge the explosive and drive it into a nearby enemy, you need to deal damage with the shotgun. At the right amount of damage, the explosive will charge up, and then you can use it. It’s genius in its simplicity.

notes.title: New frames of the upcoming season

items.text: This time, the update will bring you standard and heavy 2x2 and 2x5 frames, as well as an L-shaped 4x8 frame.
Please note that after the season ends, you will be able to get the new frames at a workbench for Engineer badges. This also applies to frames introduced in the current season, “The New Frontier”.
And this is only the beginning! See you in the next entry, coming very soon. Stay tuned.
Fixed a bug that made it impossible to buy a repair kit during a raid.
Fixed a bug that caused an incorrect amount of Clan Wars score points to be displayed in the notification centre after the battle.
Fixed a number of bugs that led to game client and server instability.

releases.displayName: Crossout: Invisible Observers come out of the shadows

items.text: You’ve got something on your nose, survivor

We wanted to come clean: there are some things we didn’t tell you about in “The New Frontier” patch notes. The thing is, there was actually a new faction added to the game with the update: the Invisible Devs Observers! It’s hard to find them, but we still managed to gather some information about the new Valley residents.

The Observers observed the game and decided to add some new mechanics to it. They created a whole new update for the game, which is already on the live server when this text is published. Let’s take a look at it!

The origins of this faction remain unclear. The mysterious Observers keep to the shadows (oftentimes they live in underground tunnels) and show themselves to the survivors only in the times of most dire need. Their leader seems familiar though, but it’s just a hunch…

Some say that the faction is connected to the creation of Crossout. Others believe that Observers are just a group of ordinary survivors who decided to take control of the Valley’s future. Nobody knows anything for sure, but it’s undeniable that Observers have much influence over the world of Crossout.

notes.title: CM Hunt event is now Dev Hunt event

items.text: Our community managers like to venture into the Wasteland from time to time and give players a chance to say thank you in person or to completely destroy them. And now this event has reached a new level.

The Dev Hunt is a new daily event that has the developers play the game every day until they “understand the experience of playing Crossout”. And survivors will have a lot of opportunities to loot the legendary “Hater” and “Development team” patches.

P.S. There is a small nuance, however. If a developer is in the battle, the team that they’re put into will automatically win. If both teams have developers in them, all the non-developer players will be destroyed and the battle is won by both teams at once. Because all developers are on the same team.

Thanks to the arrival of the Invisible Observers, the personal Q&A sessions with the developers will now take place in players’ garages. Just imagine: you came up with a question for the dev team, you send it to the game chat and the answer is instantly displayed under the “BATTLE” button! You think this is a joke? No, this is reality.

notes.title: The invisible hand of the market

items.text: The rumors that uranium will soon depreciate are getting more prominent. Observers dealt with the problem before it happened and set a fixed price for the game’s main valuable treasure: 9.99 gold for 10 uranium ore! You’re welcome.

notes.title: Selecting talents in battle on each prestige level

items.text: The Observers saw that players want new rewards for prestige levels with the Engineers faction. After meticulously studying the video games market, they came up with a genius solution, which will also greatly improve the game’s balance.

Each prestige level will unlock a choice of a battle talent that will greatly affect your performance. The higher the level, the more talents you will have to choose from in battle. Ten talents? Twenty? There’s no limit! At high prestige levels, you will spend at least 10 minutes each battle just to see all talents available to you! The gameplay will be so diverse!

notes.title: No more Battle Passes. Gacha loot boxes all the way!

items.text: How do you do fellow kids? The Observers heard that testing your luck is the latest trend in games, so they decided to reshape the game’s monetization system accordingly.
Now you can get modules, weapons, and every piece of content in Crossout only from loot boxes. There are no downsides of this change, because “random is the new fun!”

notes.title: Something funny for the 1st of April

items.text: This update is very important and serious, but with the release date being April 1, there should be at least one funny thing added to the game with it. The Observers decided to add a new humorous weapon to the game: the “Clown Catapult”.

Is that clown bothering you? Use the new cannon. It shoots balloons that deal no damage, but attach to the enemy car, raise it into the air and carry it far away over the horizon (armoured aircraft be like 🗿). Finally, a new support weapon in Crossout!

Let’s not forget the holiday presents. All survivors will receive a gift of 1 piece of Engineer badges, scrap metal, copper, wires, plastic, electronics, batteries, and uranium ore upon logging into the game. Enjoy!
Implemented some visual improvements for the “Cradle of mind” location and fixed a number of bugs related to environmental objects.
Fixed a bug that caused the battle location to not be displayed in the “Bedlam” mode description.
Fixed a bug that made it impossible to freely rotate a car blueprint around its axis in the in-game store.
Fixed a bug that caused the penetration ability parameter to not be displayed in the “Compiler” cannon parameters.
Improved visual and sounds effects for the “Compiler” cannon.
Fixed a bug that caused incorrect functionality of the “To battle” button in the battle results window of the “Clan confrontation” mode.
The “El Diablo gorge” map is now available for battles with armoured aircraft in the “Game center”.
Corrected the firing sound of the “Athena” revolver.

releases.displayName: The Founders are in play again. New features of the major March update. Part 3

items.text: Part 1
Part 2

Hello, survivors! Let’s continue talking about the new features of the upcoming Founders season. In this entry, we’ll share some information about the legendary shotgun and epic wheels, as well as reveal the new map and something very special: animated effects for your player profile. Let’s take a look!

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This applies not only to information about possible unique features of new parts, but also to the appearance of the parts themselves.
The Founders love unusual shotguns, and the famous “Parser” is a prime example of that. This time, they have a curious double-barreled one for you. It would be perfect to fight off hordes of demons.
The new shotgun makes two controlled shots before reloading. As you deal damage, it charges the perk that will allow you to deal massive damage to the enemy.

When the perk is charged, the shotgun switches to the second shooting mode, in which you fire from both barrels at the same time. You can take several shots and reload in this mode. By the end of this barrage, the enemy will have little durability left: the perk not only allows firing from both barrels, but also increases the damage and impulse of the weapon. You will be pleased as your opponents find themselves in the world of hurt; just don’t miss.

Have you ever dreamt of looking down on your enemies? And we’re not talking about literally looking down from an armoured aircraft. The Founders have a way of rising above everyone else with the new special epic wheels.

notes.title: The new movement parts can rise and lower as you command

items.text: the standard “high” suspension mode can help you with viewing the battlefield from a higher point, and also increases your resistance to all incoming damage. Your cabin will get a penalty to power in this mode, but knowing when to switch between modes will allow you to bypass this limitation.

the “low” suspension mode has your armoured car at the same level as the other typical vehicles, but the power of the cabin becomes significantly higher. This is a perfect opportunity for those who like firing from a long range and quickly changing positions when trouble comes their way.

notes.title: Animated profile frames and updated game activities UI

items.text: The upcoming update will bring a rework of the game activities interface. We won’t spoil much, but here is an example of our vision for the leaderboards:
There will be many various improvements to the interface, for example:
The ability to quickly switch between leagues, search by players’ nicknames and clan names;
The ability to click your own nickname and make the list center on it with no more scrolling to find yourself in the table;
The “Battle for uranium” description is now located in the “Clan” tab instead of the “Select mode” window.
And that’s not all! The full list of changes will be published in the patch notes.

We are also introducing a new type of profile customization: animated effects! Those beautiful accessories are not so easy to get. The effects will be given as a reward for high positions in the leaderboard of the “Battle for uranium” event.

The frames will not stay with the winners forever, and each season will have different effects among the trophies. The process is as follows: take a high place in the event and receive the frame; but when the next “Battle for uranium” ends, the frame will disappear from your account. To constantly display a gorgeous profile design, you need to steadily hold high positions and prove your status.

notes.title: Here is an example of a player profile with the effect

items.text: Please note that these are not the final versions of visual elements yet. Some elements may change during the development process.

The secret facility hides something even more secret and very important for the future of the entire Wasteland and the history of the Crossout world. You can learn more about the new battlefield from the upcoming location panorama, which will be published after the release of the update.
But we can still reveal one fact: this map will be the first truly two-level battlefield in Crossout!

This entry concludes the series of posts about the new season, and you can find out about all the rewards and new features on our livestream before the update, which will take place next week. Stay tuned and good luck in battles!

releases.displayName: The Founders are in play again. New features of the major March update. Part 2

items.text: Part 1

Hello, survivors! Let’s continue talking about the new features of the upcoming Founders season. In this entry, we’ll share some information about legendary parts: a heavy cabin and a cannon with two modes of firing. We also recently mentioned two new frames in our social media posts. Are you intrigued? Let’s take a look!

We remind you that all the new features described in the “Developer blog” are not final and may be changed before they are introduced into the game or may not make it into the game at all. This applies not only to information about possible unique features of new parts, but also to the appearance of the parts themselves.

Can Founders return without bringing a cabin from a heavy construction machine? No way. The new heavy cabin encourages heroically taking damage during battles, since it is the slowest and the most massive one in the game.

But while you’re tanking, you’re also powering up. The parameters of the cabin increase when you take damage. And not just in big spikes of boosting just one, all characteristics of the cabin gradually improve over time. The bonuses accumulate until the end of the battle.
Founders love parts that can switch modes. The new legendary cannon is a flexible tool of destruction with impressive vertical aiming angles, which is quite in line with its general concept.

The main firing mode is the same as of a classic cannon that fires on a ballistic trajectory. The only difference is that the new legendary cannon can fire a burst of several projectiles. If you hit your targets, you can activate the perk that allows you to switch to the second firing mode. It turns your cannon into an artillery weapon that fires on a plunging trajectory. Each shot in this mode deals massive damage. No enemy can hide from this cannon.

A really generous gift from the Founders indeed! They are bringing new frames to the Crossout: 3x1, 3x3 and a special new L-shaped 3x3 frame (a surprise based on the popular demand). All new frames will be available in two variants: light and standard, making it 6 frames in total.
P.S. We are happy to receive your feedback about new types and sizes of frames in the game. We will try to add more new frames in the future updates.
That’s all for today. The next devblog entry will be released soon, stay tuned!
Fixed a bug that caused the blueprints prepared for the “Clan Confrontation” to sometimes change after the “Blueprints” tab update.

Empty blueprint slots no longer merge into one upon relaunching the game until they are fully cleared. Deleting a blueprint slot before quitting the game can now be undone with the “Undo changes” button while hovering over the cleared slot.
Added a counter of unlocked blueprint slots.
Updated the effects for the Exhibition blueprint preview window.
